text.p: Centerior Energy Corp said Wednesday it is reorganizing its Sales & Marketing department.

The reorganization creates a new department called New Business Development and Economic Development that will focus on emerging, non-traditional business areas, including telecommunications-related businesses, energy marketing and energy management, Centerior said.
The company's Commercial and Industrial marketing efforts are being combined into one unit called Business to Business Marketing.

"We are responding to what's happening in the marketplace," said Al Temple, vice president of Sales & Marketing. "We are making a stronger commitment to sales and to growth in our marketing programs."
Centerior said several promotions were made in conjunction with the announcement:
-- Rick Martin, formerly manager, Consumer Marketing, was promoted to director, Sales, where he will oversee the company's sales efforts and report directly to Temple.

-- Elizabeth Richards was promoted to manager, Business to Business Marketing, and Bob Mong was named manager, Consumer & Direct Marketing. Richards was formerly a senior market development specialist, while Mong served as a commercial marketing segment specialist. They will report to Bill Ridmann, director, Marketing.
-- Mike Nelson, formerly supervisor, Sales Support, was promoted to manager, Sales Support.
-- Wally Hartory was promoted to sales manager, Commercial. He was a Commercial National Accounts sales representative. -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.
